steps.position: Now the left hand. Put your little finger (5) on the {c} below middle {c}, and each finger on the next white key. Your thumb (1) lands on {g}.
steps.up: Play up from finger 5 to finger 1.
steps.down: And back down, from your thumb to your little finger.
steps.withMetronome: Now with the metronome: up and back down.
